blocks.title: Service Desk overview
blocks.body: This document provides a high-level snapshot of support operations: ticket volumes by priority, monthly submission trends, customer satisfaction scores broken down by ticket category, and cumulative refund liability.

blocks.caption: Ticket distribution across priority levels — use this to identify backlogs in urgent and high-priority queues.
Monthly ticket volume trend — highlights seasonal spikes and the effect of product releases on support load.
Cumulative refund spend — tracks total financial exposure from customer refund and return requests.
